payer: EXIM Bank (Export-Import Bank of the United States)
recipient: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Côte d'Ivoire
title: US EXIM Bank — Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Commerce and Industry digitalisation, 2025
description:
Fraternité Matin (2025-08-26): "après le vote par le Conseil d'administration le 14 août, l'octroi de 47 millions de dollars (28,2 milliards FCFA) pour la numérisation du ministère du Commerce et de l'Industrie." TechAfrica News (2025-09-22): "a $47 million guarantee for the digitalization of the Ministry of Finance and Industry. Cybastion, the lead exporter, will work with U.S. technology partners such as Cisco, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, and Schneider Electric."

We Are Tech Africa (on the EXIM board approval): "The Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) board of directors approved... a $47 million financing package for the digitization of Côte d'Ivoire's Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The project will be implemented by the Washington-based Cybastion Institute of Technology in partnership with technology giants such as Cisco, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Motorola Solutions, and Microsoft" — to "modernize the ministry's information systems, strengthen cybersecurity, integrate cloud solutions, and improve administrative efficiency." Per EXIM acting chairman James Cruse the transaction supports around 100 U.S. jobs and counters the rise of PRC influence, framed as a China and Transformational Exports Program (CTEP) transaction.

payer: EXIM Bank (Export-Import Bank of the United States)
recipient: Côte d'Ivoire national data centre / Ministère de la Transition numérique et de la Digitalisation
title: US EXIM Bank — Côte d'Ivoire national data centre, 2025
description:
"The Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) has approved a $66 million guarantee to fund the construction of a national data center in Côte d'Ivoire. The project is set to be a significant milestone for the region, marking the first data center EXIM has ever supported in sub-Saharan Africa." "The initiative is part of EXIM's China and Transformational Exports Program... The equipment for the data center will be supplied by Cybastion Institute of Technology, LLC, a Washington, DC-based small business."

Fraternité Matin (2025-08-26) reports the same approval as "66 millions de dollars (39,6 milliards FCFA)... destiné à soutenir la construction du Centre national de données de Côte d'Ivoire, sous l'égide du ministère de la Transition numérique et de la Digitalisation."

recipient: Republic of Cote d'Ivoire
title: IDA - Republic of Cote d'Ivoire, Digital Acceleration Project (PADCI / RAPID-CI) phase 1, 2025
description:
From the Conseil des ministres communique of 4 February 2026, verbatim:

> Le Conseil des ministres du 04 fevrier 2026 a adopte un decret portant ratification de l'accord de pret d'un montant de 84 356 070 200 FCFA conclu le 17 octobre 2025 entre l'Association internationale de developpement (AID) et la Republique de Cote d'Ivoire pour le financement du projet d'acceleration digitale en Cote d'Ivoire (PADCI) phase 1, dans le cadre de l'approche programmatique multiphase.

> le projet a pour objectif d'accroitre l'utilisation inclusive et resiliente de l'Internet a haut debit et des services numeriques dans certains secteurs sociaux cibles.

> Il prevoit notamment la fourniture d'une assistance technique et d'equipement pour creer et rendre operationnels les agences numeriques et les cadres de gouvernance de l'intelligence artificielle et de developper des competences numeriques avancees et intermediaires en ciblant particulierement les jeunes et les femmes.

The connectivity component is scoped to public facilities - schools, health centres, social centres, town halls, sub-prefectures, courts, post offices and regional directorates - with the stated aim of improving access to digital public services for remote and vulnerable populations.

description: On September 11, 2018, the Government of Côte d’Ivoire signed a CFA 42,754,805,764.67 buyer’s credit loan agreement with Bank of China for the Armed Services Integrated Information System Establishment Project (as captured via Project ID#97787). Then, on March 6, 2019, the Government of Côte d’Ivoire signed a CFA 7,018,739,900 buyer’s credit loan agreement with Bank of China for the Armed Services Integrated Information System Establishment Project (as captured via Project ID#97788). The borrowing terms of the Bank of China loans are unknown. However, it is known that the borrower was expected to use the proceeds of the CFA 42,754,805,764.67 loan to finance 85% of the cost of a commercial contract with an unspecified Chinese contractor. It is also known that the borrower was expected to use the proceeds of the CFA 7,018,739,900 loan to finance 15% of the cost of the same commercial contract.   The CFA 42,754,805,764.67 loan achieved a 98% disbursement rate (CFA 42,077,004,262 out of CFA 42,754,805,764.67). 6 disbursements took place between 2019 and 2020: a CFA 9,568,049,781 disbursement on June 30, 2019, a CFA 15,478,003,812 disbursement on October 31, 2019, a CFA 10,938,194,160 disbursement on January 31, 2020, a CFA 3,896,402,757 disbursement on March 31, 2020, a CFA 827,825,441 disbursement on May 31, 2020, and a CFA 1,368,528,311 disbursement on August 31, 2020. The CFA 7,018,739,900 loan fully disbursed on April 30, 2019. According to the Government of Côte d’Ivoire’s Aid Management Platform (PGFE), the project was completed on December 31, 2020.

description: On August 31, 2018, the Government of Côte d'Ivoire signed a set of loan agreements with Bank of China for Phase 1 of the Digital Education Project (captured via Project ID#89413 and Project ID#91764) and Phase 1 of the Ministry of Interior and Security Unified Communication System Project (captured via Project ID#89415 and Project ID#92201). According to the Government of Côte d'Ivoire’s Aid Management Platform (AMP), Bank of China signed two loan agreements with the Government of Côte d'Ivoire for Phase 1 of the Digital Education Project: a CFA 53,267,282,421.07 loan agreement (captured via Project ID#89413) and a CFA 8,724,228,100 loan agreement (captured via Project ID#917648). The borrower was expected to use the proceeds of the CFA 53,267,282,421.07 loan to finance 85% of the cost of the commercial contract between Huawei and Côte d'Ivoire’s Ministry of National Education and Literacy. It was expected to use the proceeds of the CFA 8,724,228,100 loan to finance 15% of the cost of the commercial contract between Huawei and Côte d'Ivoire’s Ministry of National Education and Literacy. A single disbursement was made under the CFA 8,724,228,100 loan: a CFA 8,743,486,998 disbursement on June 30, 2019. recipient: Ministry of National Education and Literacy (MENET-FP), Government of Côte d'Ivoire / MCA-Côte d'Ivoire
title: Côte d'Ivoire Compact — Education Management Information System (EMIS / SIGE Intégré), Management Systems Sub-Activity
description: MCC's $536.7M Côte d'Ivoire Compact (signed November 2017, entered force August 2019, closed August 2025) included an Education Management Information System (EMIS, French: Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Education — SIGE Intégré) as the Management Systems for Decision-Making sub-activity within the Secondary Education Activity of the Skills for Employability and Productivity Project. MCC funded development and implementation of an integrated EMIS for the Ministry of National Education (MENET-FP), centralising data across HR, school management, examinations, and student assessments into a single platform. The system supports national and international student assessments (ENIA), monitoring of ~80 new secondary schools, and data-driven decision-making. Implementation contract QCBS/011 was valued at approximately $4.3 million for the consultant services component; additional hardware/software goods procurement was issued separately. Development Gateway / IREX provided data assessment and requirements support. System designed with five functional components: unified education reference data, HR management, sector statistics and monitoring, school management, and examination management.
